title: Mosaic Keeper of Shattered Names
description: A surreal mosaic portrait of an elderly woman with cracked, multicolored tile-like skin and piercing eyes is centered within a glowing circular frame. She is surrounded by floating scrolls bearing similar mosaic faces, glowing potion bottles, hanging lanterns, a bowl of colorful broken fragments, and swirling purple and red smoke against a dark, mystical background.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of an elderly woman's face rendered as a cracked mosaic of green, red, and teal tiles with gold grout lines, floating inside an ornate circular frame. She has purple eyeshadow and red lips. Floating around her are ancient scrolls with similar mosaic faces, glowing potion bottles, dried herbs, hanging lanterns, and a wooden bowl filled with colorful broken mosaic pieces. Swirling purple and red magical smoke fills the dark background with faint glowing runes.
